Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Come here, quick! I just found all the foil cards from the Camp Totally Safe Superdrop inside this trashed cabin. I assumed all the shimmering on the ground was just reflections from the broken window and the broken mirror and that huge knife. But it’s actually from all the beautiful, shining foil cards! I guess a wild raccoon must’ve broken in looking for food. Oh well, snag those foils!

• 1x Secret Lair x Ghostbusters: The Real Ghostbusters Foil Edition
